sequential_dependency.intermediate: The complete cleaned grid after singleton erasure; formerly blocking singleton cells are now zero while every component of size at least two is preserved.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Remove every nonzero same-color 4-connected component of size one, producing a cleaned grid of surviving components.
sequential_dependency.step_b: On the cleaned grid, find same-color row or column spans with at least four surviving cells and only zeroes between their endpoints, then fill those zeroes with that color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Singleton blockers intentionally interrupt one otherwise valid span in the raw input. Stage B can detect and fill that span only after Stage A removes the blocker; bridging before erasure leaves the span incomplete and changes the final grid.
